workflow_runs.name: Codespell
workflow_runs.display_title: fix(tui): restore fuzzy matching fallback for slash-command popup

head_commit.message:
fix(tui): restore fuzzy matching fallback for slash-command popup

Re-enable fuzzy/substring matching as a fallback in the slash-command
autocomplete popup. The matching order is now:
1. Exact matches (highest priority)
2. Prefix matches
3. Fuzzy matches (lowest priority, sorted by score)

This restores the ability to type `/ac` and see `/compact` as a match,
which was removed in PR #9629.

Fixes #9741

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
